content: Quasi-steady lap-time simulation is a simplification of optimal control and uses track curvature, grip and aero constraints; parameters fitted only to lap time can be confounded because public data lacks direct car setup and tyre temperature/pressure. Use identifiability checks, priors/bounds, sensitivity, multi-lap evidence and external validation, and state the point-mass model scope. Sources: https://www.mdpi.com/2076-3417/10/4/1498 ; https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:ce1a7106-0a2c-41af-8449-41541220809f/files/m776aa23411ad9d78c36f96620a0e0f0b ; https://openf1.org/docs/
